packageRules.description: Hold every update for 7 days so a malicious or yanked release is caught before it lands
A digest update carries no release timestamp, so under the default timestamp-required its stability-days status would stay pending forever; the hold still applies where the registry gives a timestamp
invisible-playwright pins invisible-core to an exact version and the lock follows that pin, so only invisible-playwright gets update PRs
Release runs on the better-semantic-release fork — never let an update swap it back to upstream python-semantic-release
